params.name: trans
params.reference:
On entry, `TRANS` specifies the operation to be performed as follows:

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'N'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'n'} y := \alpha \, A \, x + \beta \, y
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'T'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'t'} y := \alpha \, A^T \, x + \beta \, y
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'C'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'c'} y := \alpha \, A^H \, x + \beta \, y
$$

params.name: M
params.reference: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of the matrix A. M must be at least zero.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of the matrix A. N must be at least zero.

params.name: kl
params.reference: On entry, `KL` specifies the number of sub-diagonals of the matrix A. `KL` must satisfy 0 .le. `KL`.

params.name: ku
params.reference: On entry, `KU` specifies the number of super-diagonals of the matrix A. `KU` must satisfy 0 .le. `KU`.

params.name: A
params.reference:
Before entry, the leading ( kl + ku + 1 ) by n part of the array A must contain the matrix of coefficients, supplied column by column, with the leading diagonal of the matrix in row ( ku + 1 ) of the array, the first super-diagonal starting at position 2 in row ku, the first sub-diagonal starting at position 1 in row ( ku + 2 ), and so on. Elements in the array A that do not correspond to elements in the band matrix (such as the top left ku by ku triangle) are not referenced. The following program segment will transfer a band matrix from conventional full matrix storage to band storage:

```text
   DO 20, J = 1, N
      K = KU + 1 - J
      DO 10, I = MAX( 1, J - KU ), MIN( M, J + KL )
         A( K + I, J ) = matrix( I, J )
10    CONTINUE
20 CONTINUE
```

params.name: lda
params.reference: On entry, `LDA` specifies the first dimension of A as declared in the calling (sub) program. `LDA` must be at least ( kl + ku + 1 ).

params.name: x
params.reference: ( 1 + ( n - 1 )\*abs( `INCX` ) ) when `TRANS = 'N'` or 'n' and at least ( 1 + ( m - 1 )\*abs( `INCX` ) ) otherwise. Before entry, the incremented array X must contain the vector x.

params.name: incx
params.reference: On entry, `INCX` specifies the increment for the elements of X. `INCX` must not be zero.

params.name: beta
params.reference: On entry, `BETA` specifies the scalar $\beta$. When `BETA` is supplied as zero then Y need not be set on input.

params.name: y
params.reference: ( 1 + ( m - 1 )\*abs( `INCY` ) ) when `TRANS = 'N'` or 'n' and at least ( 1 + ( n - 1 )\*abs( `INCY` ) ) otherwise. Before entry, the incremented array Y must contain the vector y. On exit, Y is overwritten by the updated vector y. If either m or n is zero, then Y not referenced and the function performs a quick return.

params.name: incy
params.reference: On entry, `INCY` specifies the increment for the elements of Y. `INCY` must not be zero.

quickReturn.js: (M === 0 || N === 0) || (real( alpha ) === 0 && imag( alpha ) === 0 && (real( beta ) === 1 && imag( beta ) === 0))
